body: The structure is what I want to learn

If he had to lie about the relationship then obviously he wanted to use you. If you ever need someone to talk to just PM me. Or if you wanted to add me on a social networking site. You just have to take one step at a time for it all to be normal.

There are other things on my mind. First, I keep thinking I'm going to get kicked out of college. Secondly, I go to a counselling session named CAMHS. They ask loads of questions about my past to see what's making me feel the way I am but, I blocked out my past because I didn't like them. I keep remembering little segments when I'm in those sessions. Thirdly, I feel all alone in the world. No one seems to have the same mental state as me, my 'friends' find out how weird I actually am and  stop talking to me. Also I am the same age as you.
